claims.claim_text: LSI (acquired) serves 'aerospace and defense, sensing and instrumentation, and optical communications' customers; QCi positions LSI as a defense-applications photonics supplier.
claims.subject: Luminar Semiconductor Inc.

Acquiring LSI provides QCi with advanced semiconductors and related components, as well as design, testing and consulting services to industry, in particular for Aerospace and Defense applications.
